action: Equinor partners and suppliers: no action required yet. Follow Equinor's official updates, treat unexpected emails that appear to come from Equinor with extra care, and confirm payment or access requests by phone.
exec: A major European energy supplier is under active attack; operations are reported unaffected, but the situation is still developing.
plain: Norwegian energy company Equinor said on November 17 it had detected an ongoing cyberattack on some of its computer systems. It says oil and gas production is unaffected and there is no sign that data was stolen.
summary: The Norwegian energy group said on November 17 that it had detected an ongoing cyberattack against certain IT systems and mobilized resources to neutralize it. Equinor says operations and production are unaffected and there are no indications data was stolen. It has not named an attacker or the systems involved.
title: Equinor detects ongoing cyberattack on IT systems; production unaffected
